name: Custody transfer metering (ultrasonic, Coriolis)
applications: fiscal metering of crude, products and gas
principle: Meters that set the invoice value of oil or gas. Ultrasonic transit-time meters infer velocity from the difference in pulse travel times with and against the flow; Coriolis meters measure mass flow and density directly. Cone meters reach ±0.5% when calibrated.

process_steps.name: Flow computer corrects for pressure and temperature
Prove against a master meter or prover

source.note: Wikipedia, Coriolis flowmeter / flow measurement, read 25 October 2026 (secondary source)

advantages: Coriolis gives direct mass flow and density
limitations: Transit-time meters lose accuracy with bubbles or particles
